name: cern-x
description: CERN-X: Interactive, open-source digital representation of CERN's scientific ecosystem
author: Premchand Yadav <premchand.23bce7167@vitapstudent.ac.in>

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@cern-x/content-schema && npm run build --workspace=@cern-x/sim-core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@cern-x/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cern-x/content-schema && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cern-x/sim-core && npx --prefix apps/web tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:manifest && npm run test:physics && npm run typecheck && npm run build
